Every routed expert is present and each expert family uses one tier consistently for gate_proj, up_proj, and down_proj, including the model's three integrated dSpark blocks. sources.title: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731-EXL3-K2.1-D2.2-calibrated-v3
sources.snippet: An inference runtime must support DeepSeek V4, the EXL3 MCG codebook, and projection-mixed K2/K3 trellises. This remains a standard, unsliced Hugging Face sharded checkpoint with every expert present. Use the tokenizer and prompt formatting documented by the original model. The quantization pipeline is built on GPTQModel and ExLlamaV3.
